meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会逐个完整读完代码库里的每一个源文件，文件多也不跳过；大文件用 Read 工具的 offset 和 limit 分页按块读，以建立对整个代码库的理解。
howto.when: 当你说 “learn the codebase”、“read the codebase” 等关键词，或开始接触新项目、不熟悉的项目时触发。

say.note: Claude 会完整读完所有源文件

say.text: 读完这个项目的全部源码
帮我熟悉这个项目，先读完代码
say.note: 先通读代码再开始工作

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads every source file in the codebase in full, no matter how many there are; large files are paged with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters to build understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say “learn the codebase”, “read the codebase”, “prime” etc.

say_en.note: Claude reads every source file in full
Reads all sources, paging large files

say_en.text: Help me get up to speed on this project
say_en.note: Primes by reading the full codebase
